chunks: No calamity befalls unless God dispenses. He guides the heart of whosoever believes in God; and God has knowledge of everything.
ai.seo_question: How does belief in God lead to guidance of the heart according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tradition as a standalone hadith or part of the Quranic narrative, underscores the concept of *al-musibah* (calamity) as a direct manifestation of divine will (*bi-idhnillah*), linking external trials to internal spiritual stability. It promises that true faith (*iman*) results in the guidance of the heart (*yahdi qalbah*), a key theme in Shia exegesis regarding the purification of the soul through adversity. The affirmation of God's omniscience serves as the theological foundation for this causal relationship, ensuring that no event occurs without His knowledge and permission.
